latest.title: Better, faster, stronger: BribeBank's latest update is here!
features: Admin Approvals has been refactored into a Manage tab with unified task/reward management.
Parents and children can now cancel unverified tasks to close stale assignments cleanly.
improvements: Parents are now prompted to set up a family recovery key to avoid account lockouts.
Added a one-time 'BribeBank was updated' modal with categorized release highlights.
fixes: Password changes now immediately invalidate stale sessions so old tokens can no longer be used.
Users are now automatically returned to login as soon as a stale session is detected.
Fixed mobile update modal clipping by making update dialogs viewport-safe and scrollable.
FCFS tasks now close lifecycle history for users who missed the claim, including who claimed first.
Admin and wallet history now use one newest-first activity feed instead of split lifecycle/legacy sections.
Corrected task lifecycle status handling for denied-without-resubmit outcomes in wallet history.
Added a self-hoster emergency CLI recovery path when no family recovery key is available.
Stabilized update delivery by replacing manual update confirmation with immediate automatic refresh.
